prd: Ten-Percent Days — Paper Trade Simulation Engine v1 (owner, 2026-09-18) + design docs/Paper Trade Engine standalone (1).html
immutable: These rules are fixed at registration. Any change is a new rules_id and is never applied retroactively. No threshold here may be tuned after outcomes are seen.

model.name: v4
model.source_forward: /app/research/tpd3_forward/snapshots_v4/<target_session>/ (frozen, sha256 in manifest.json; model of record; v4d not used)
model.not_produced_policy: stored NULL and shown as not produced; never synthesised

samples.forward: Predictions frozen nightly by run_v4.sh. Counts toward the forward evaluation only when the snapshot's generated_at is after this rule set's registration commit time (counts_from). Earlier forward sessions are recorded and shown, labelled 'before registration', and excluded from every forward statistic.
samples.replay: The same engine over the v4 early-window walk-forward predictions. Shown as 'historical replay'. Never pooled with the forward sample in any statistic. Caveat on record: that window informed v4 decisions.

eligibility.applied_at: EOD of prediction_date using only bars dated on or before it

filters.rule: the symbol has an estimate for the portfolio's head in the frozen snapshot
a bar exists for prediction_date with open, high, low, close > 0, low <= min(open, close) and high >= max(open, close)
the symbol's latest bar is dated prediction_date (not stale)
median daily turnover over the 20 sessions ending prediction_date >= 1.0e7 INR (1 crore), with at least 15 bars in that window
no suspected corporate action in the 20 sessions ending prediction_date: an open/previous-close ratio <= 0.6 or >= 1.6 with no known action that day (backtest.suspected_actions)
at least 15 adjusted bars ending prediction_date so ATR14 is defined

eligibility.circuit_filter_at_selection: none in v1 (circuit handling happens at entry)
eligibility.excluded_rows: stored in the ranked universe with selection_status EXCLUDED, the first failing filter id, rank NULL

ranking: eligible rows by the portfolio head's probability descending, ties by symbol ascending; top 5 = SELECTED, the rest NOT_SELECTED

entry.price: official open of next_trading_session (NSE bhavcopy open via nidp.prices_eod, EQ series)
entry.source: NSE_BHAVCOPY / NSE_SEC_BHAVDATA as recorded on the bar
entry.next_session: the frozen snapshot's target_session (forward) or the walk-forward target_session (replay); both come from the NSE cash-market calendar
entry.adjustment: if a known corporate action is ex-dated on the entry session, the gap is measured against the adjusted previous close

exceptions.MISSING_OPEN: bar exists but open is missing or <= 0 -> ENTRY_UNAVAILABLE
exceptions.SUSPENDED: no bar on the entry session while the market traded -> SUSPENDED, no trade
exceptions.UPPER_CIRCUIT_OPEN: open == high and the gap from the (adjusted) previous close is within 0.25 percentage points of a standard band (2, 5, 10, 20%) -> ENTRY_UNAVAILABLE (no fill assumed at a locked price)
exceptions.LOWER_CIRCUIT_OPEN: open == low and the gap is within 0.25 pp of minus a standard band -> entered (a long can be bought into a lower circuit) and flagged
exceptions.GAP_RECORDED: |open / (adjusted) previous close - 1| >= 5% -> entered and flagged; never silently rejected
exceptions.CORPORATE_ACTION_REVIEW: a suspected (unexplained) corporate action inside the observation window -> status CORPORATE_ACTION_REVIEW, excluded from automatic evaluation
exceptions.CAPACITY: allocation above 1% of the entry session's turnover -> entered and flagged ILLIQUID_OPEN

allocation.weights: equal, 20% per position (fixed notional 20,000 INR); an unfilled position's capital stays idle (not re-allocated)

costs.applied: net = gross - cost, on the entry notional; recorded separately from gross

sessions.numbering: s1 = entry session (entry day), s2..s6 = the five sessions after it (PRD 7.1 'Day 1..Day 5'). Observation window s1..s6.
sessions.calendar: NSE cash-market sessions as present in the price panel (weekends, holidays and special sessions follow the exchange); muhurat sessions are not counted

modes.EOD-1: exit at the close of s1 (end of the entry day)
modes.EOD-3: exit at the close of s3 (end of the third session)
modes.EOD-5: exit at the close of s5 (end of the fifth session)
modes.FIXED: no early exit; exit at the close of s6 (end of the full observation window, PRD 7.1 'Day 5 close')
modes.TARGET_STOP: first barrier within s1..s6, else the close of s6 (same horizon as FIXED so the pair isolates the barrier effect)

headline_mode: EOD-1 (PRD: next-session portfolios are evaluated over 1 day; EOD-3/EOD-5/FIXED/TARGET_STOP reported alongside, never promoted after results)
primary_observation: no forced target/stop; the path is recorded

target_stop.target: entry * (1 + target_pct/100); target_1 = entry*1.05 and target_2 = entry*1.10 are both recorded
target_stop.atr: Wilder ATR(14) on corporate-action-adjusted bars ending prediction_date (known at EOD)
target_stop.support: lowest adjusted low of the 10 sessions ending prediction_date
target_stop.resistance: highest adjusted high of the 20 sessions ending prediction_date (recorded, not used)
target_stop.stop: min(entry - atr_multiplier*ATR14, support) when support < entry, else entry - atr_multiplier*ATR14; then at least entry*(1-0.08) (8% maximum risk)
target_stop.same_session_tie: if a session's range contains both the stop and the target, the stop counts (conservative)
target_stop.gaps: a session (s2..s6) opening at/above the target exits at that open; opening at/below the stop exits at that open
target_stop.fill: at the barrier price, or the open when gapped through

labels.model_label_hit: the model's own label: s1 high >= previous close * (1 + target_pct/100) (as v4's y, measured from the prior close)
labels.trade_target_hit: high >= entry * (1 + target_pct/100) within the mode's horizon (measured from the paper entry)

benchmarks.A_ALL: equal-weight average of every eligible, entered stock in the same session's ranked universe, same entry and exits
benchmarks.A_RANDOM5: 5 eligible entered stocks drawn with numpy default_rng(seed) where seed = int(sha256('A|<portfolio>|<entry_session>|paper-v1')[:16], 16)
benchmarks.B_MATCHED: for each selected stock in rank order: candidates = eligible, entered, not selected, not yet used; keep the same sector if >= 3 candidates remain, then the same size group (turnover rank within the ranked universe: 1-100, 101-250, 251+) if >= 3 remain; z-score log ATR%, log close and log 20-session median turnover over the candidates plus the stock; take the 5 nearest by Euclidean distance and draw one with default_rng(seed of 'B|<portfolio>|<entry_session>|<symbol>|paper-v1')
benchmarks.C_MOVEMENT: top 5 eligible by (head + opposite head) probability — movement without the direction split — entered long at the same open, same exits
benchmarks.D_NIFTY50: Nifty 50 from s1 open to the mode's exit close; source nidp.index_eod (NSE_IND_CLOSE) where present, else Yahoo ^NSEI; source recorded per row

evaluation.bucket_population: every eligible, entered row of the ranked universe (prediction level); a selected-only view is shown separately
evaluation.calibration_error: observed model-label hit rate minus mean predicted probability, per bucket
evaluation.portfolio_level: daily mark-to-market series: each session, the equal-weight mean daily return of the cohorts open that session (overlapping cohorts share capital equally); no compounding, cumulative sum
evaluation.confidence_intervals: 95% on the session-cohort mean series; EOD-1 = session-clustered (sd/sqrt(n)); multi-session modes = Newey-West HAC with lag = horizon - 1; incremental edge = paired session difference vs A_ALL with the same method
evaluation.minimum_sample_for_a_statement: an edge is described as established only with >= 60 counted sessions AND a 95% CI excluding zero; otherwise 'not established'
